prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single transparent low-resolution RPG dialogue head portrait. Make a substantial fresh image_gen redraw, not a crop of the full-body image.
Input images: FIRST image is identity and outfit reference ONLY. Images 2, 3, 4 and 5 are the approved Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore style references ONLY. Match their coarse native-game dialogue portrait visual grammar and compact face-focused composition, not their identity or sad expression.
Shabo / 莎帛 / PAS-NPC-SHABO, a woman in her thirties, an ordinary practical shift nurse. Her identity is the FIRST reference image: compact round-square adult face, short broad nose with distinctly wide nostrils, slightly wider-set small low-lidded eyes, substantial lower lip and short square jaw. Clean practical SHORT dark-brown hair visible at the forehead and temple under the same fully enclosing warm ivory cloth headscarf tied at the back. The scarf is tied cloth, not a huge nun hood, no long hair. Warm natural light-medium skin. Preserve her navy-blue nursing garment with a tiny ivory apron/linen collar accent from the master; clothing only in the bottom sliver. Calm, stable, attentive, direct and matter-of-fact: almost level brows, slightly skeptical attentive gaze toward viewer-left, closed relaxed substantial mouth. She checks actual beds before accepting another patient, so composed concentration rather than sadness. Do not make a young doll, aged crone, angry villain, or same worried-brow face as the other portraits. No medical symbols or modern equipment.
Composition: portrait canvas aspect 74:100, one head facing three-quarter viewer-left. Design on an exact 74x100 logical pixel grid, enlarged only by integer nearest-neighbor if needed. Head is large, face fills most of the central canvas, chin near logical y=84; short neck and a narrow collar occupy only the lowest 10–12 pixels. Complete natural head shape, complete scarf/hair crown, both side silhouettes and visible ear entirely inside frame. At least 3 logical pixels transparent margin above the crown and 2–3 pixels at BOTH sides; no left-side or right-side crop, no clipped hair/scarf, no border contact. Preserve generous face size within those margins. Do not crop the original reference.
Style: hard-edged intentional pixel clusters, compact mature facial anatomy, large readable nose and connected cheekbone light/shadow planes, chunky warm skin ramps with dark brown/purple outline accents, small dark eyes with at most a tiny muted off-white sclera. No huge bright white eyes. Palette of at most 32 opaque colors, alpha only 0 or 255; fully transparent surrounding canvas. Every pixel crisp: no gradients, antialiasing, dithering, smooth illustration, blurred skin, stippled texture, tiny high-resolution detail, glossy highlights or 3D shading. Hair/scarf uses a few connected stepped masses. Avoid thin long neck, broad shoulder bust, head-to-waist composition, props, lettering, border, watermark, backdrop, drop shadow, ground. Single portrait only.
